dictionary.md's _Avoid_ field is SPLIT ON COMMAS - a comma inside a parenthetical produces inert fragments that silently disable the guard. This went undetected twice and cost PR #1956 a red round. Put rationale in Definition, then PRINT the parsed aliases and confirm each is a clean standalone string.
Do not add avoid-aliases beyond this issue's scope. An unrequested addition broke an unrelated agent prompt's worked example on #1956.
Grep components, e2e spec source and the two Python contract tests BEFORE editing, not after a red. #1937 took three CI rounds by finding them one at a time.
A guard must be seen failing (.cursor/rules/code-quality.mdc, merged in #1976): print what the test collected, make it go red on purpose, report both.
Run the demo suite with `npx turbo run test --filter=@juli/demo --force` and report the `Cached:` line - a cached turbo task prints a full pass having run nothing.
Pin PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend/src:$PWD" for any pytest run inside the worktree, or the green is fake.
apps/dashboard is a different surface and is NOT in scope. #1910's rename and ACTIONS_DESTINATION_LABEL are apps/demo only.
